dji - flip drone with rc-n3 remote contr.name: DJI - Flip Drone with RC-N3 Remote Controller
dji - flip drone with rc-n3 remote contr.description: Are you ready to elevate your aerial photography experience? The DJI Flip Drone with RC-N3 Remote Controller is designed to do just that, combining a sleek, compact design with cutting-edge imaging capabilities. This innovative drone supports palm takeoff without the need for a remote controller, making it easier than ever to capture spontaneous moments. With its AI Subject Tracking feature, your main subject remains perfectly framed, allowing you to create captivating shots effortlessly.The DJI Flip Drone is equipped with a foldable full-coverage propeller guard, a first for DJI. This guard features a carbon fiber support structure that is incredibly lightweight just 1/60 the weight of traditional PC materials while maintaining exceptional stiffness. This design ensures comprehensive protection, making it ideal for beginner pilots who want to navigate the skies with confidence.Weighing less than 249 grams, the DJI Flip is as light as an apple and fits comfortably in the palm of your hand. Its compact size means you can take it anywhere without the need for training or examination in most countries and regions, making it the perfect travel companion for capturing your favorite moments.The DJI Flip simplifies flight control with a single tap. By pressing the mode button, you can select your desired shooting mode, and the drone takes care of the rest, capturing impressive footage whether you're a seasoned photographer or just starting out. The AI Subject Tracking acts as your personal director, ensuring your subject is always in the spotlight, whether you're hiking through forests or scaling peaks.Capture stunning 48MP photos with the DJI Flip's advanced camera, featuring a 1/1.3-inch CMOS sensor with Dual Native ISO Fusion, an f/1.7 aperture, and 2.4-¼m 4-in-1 pixels. This setup delivers high dynamic range images with rich highlight and shadow details. With up to 4x zoom, you can capture intricate details from afar. The next-gen SmartPhoto technology combines HDR imaging and scene recognition for vibrant images that truly pop.Record breathtaking 4K/60fps HDR video to preserve the natural beauty of any moment, from sunsets to sunrises, in true-to-life quality. The DJI Flip also supports 4K slow-motion recording at 100fps, perfect for capturing the highlights of sports and other fast-paced activities. Its 2.7K vertical shooting mode is optimized for smartphone viewing, ensuring your images are ready to share on social media without post-cropping.The 10-bit D-Log M color mode allows for recording up to one billion colors, retaining more highlight and shadow details for flexible editing. Even in high-contrast scenarios, it delivers natural color gradations with delicate details for a full-spectrum visual experience.With intelligent shooting features like MasterShots and Hyperlapse, the DJI Flip automatically performs diverse camera movements, capturing multiple clips and editing them with music, cuts, and effects for cinematic footage. FocusTrack offers creative ways to follow your subject, including ActiveTrack 4.0, Spotlight 2.0, and Point of Interest 3.0. Capture stunning panoramic photos with options for 180-degree, wide-angle, vertical, and sphere shots.Safety is paramount with the DJI Flip, which includes 3D ToF sensors for automatic braking, even at night. The DJI O4 video transmission supports up to 13 km of 1080p/60fps video transmission with excellent anti-interference capabilities. Pair it with the DJI RC-N3 or RC 2 remote controller for stable connections, even in complex environments, thanks to the DJI Cellular Dongle 2.Enjoy up to 31 minutes of flight time with the DJI Flip Intelligent Flight Battery, and reduce downtime with the Parallel Charging Hub, which charges two batteries simultaneously. Effortless takeoff is possible without a remote controller, thanks to Wi-Fi Direct and the DJI Fly app's new vertical screen interface. Voice control via the "Hey Fly" command allows for hands-free operation, while noise reduction technology ensures clear audio capture.Efficiently transfer footage to the DJI Fly app at speeds up to 30MB/s via Wi-Fi, allowing for quick editing and high-quality video creation. The DJI Flip Drone with RC-N3 Remote Controller is your gateway to unlocking new creative possibilities in aerial photography.

mount-it! - adjustable monitor & laptop.description: Create a more comfortable and organized workspace with the Mount-It! Adjustable Desktop Riser Stand. Designed for laptops, monitors, and small desktop devices, this sturdy metal stand raises screens to a more ergonomic viewing height to help reduce neck, back, and shoulder strain. Three adjustable height levels allow you to customize your setup for improved comfort throughout the day. The open space underneath provides convenient storage for keyboards, notebooks, and office accessories, helping keep your desk clutter-free. Built with a durable metal frame and protective silicone pads, this riser supports screens from 11" to 32" and holds up to 44 lbs while protecting your desk surface from scratches. Its modern ventilated design also promotes airflow to help keep devices cooler during use.

nintendo - pokemon go plus + - red.name: Nintendo - Pokémon GO Plus + - Red
nintendo - pokemon go plus + - red.description: Pokémon GO Plus + is a new device that uses Bluetooth Low Energy technology to link with the Pokémon Sleep and Pokémon GO smart device apps! With the Pokémon Sleep app, just press and hold the central button on the Pokémon GO Plus + accessory and place it by your pillow. There’s a Pikachu within your Pokémon GO Plus + that can sing you lullabies and act as your morning alarm; Pikachu grows friendlier the more you sleep, unlocking even more sounds! Depending on your rest rhythm, you can collect more Pokémon to complete the sleep Pokédex! Keep an eye on your sleep data and link to Pokémon GO to take advantage of upcoming gameplay features. With Pokémon GO, use this accessory to spin PokéStops or throw Poké Balls automatically (and Great Balls and Ultra Balls too!). You can catch Pokémon without even pressing a button! Linking Pokémon GO Plus + with Pokémon GO will also let you take on Special Research to catch a Snorlax with a nightcap. Disclaimers: Pokémon GO Plus + cannot be used with Nintendo Switch family systems. It also cannot be used on its own. This accessory requires a compatible smart device (using Android or iOS) with the Pokémon GO and/or Pokémon Sleep apps installed. Pokémon GO Plus + measures sleep based on the lack of movement. Before purchasing Pokémon GO Plus +, make sure to check the system requirements of this device as well as those of the apps it works with. If the performance of your Pokémon GO Plus + seems unstable, it may improve if you update your operating system. Please do not use Pokémon GO Plus + while operating a vehicle (car, bicycle, etc.). Pokémon Sleep can also track your rest rhythm using your smart device.
